problems.title: Cold-Chain & Solar Preservation for Potato & Tomato Farmers in Vom/Bokkos
problems.description: Post-harvest loss reaches over 40% for Plateau fresh produce due to lack of off-grid solar cold storage and direct market logistics. Founders can build IoT monitored cold hubs and order matching.

comments.author: Mark G.
comments.text: I have experience with ESP32 sensors and temperature logging. Happy to lead hardware build in Rayfield!

comments.author: Chidi O.
comments.text: We can link this to our logistics web platform for Plateau farm off-takers in Abuja and Lagos.

problems.title: Uninterrupted Mesh Internet & Power Hub for Tech Nodes across Anglo Jos & Bukuru
problems.description: Frequent power cuts and fiber outages disrupt remote engineering teams in Jos. Need a co-funded solar micro-grid + Starlink failover mesh shared among tech hubs and startups.

comments.author: Esther M.
comments.text: We can set up a shared node at our hub in Anglo Jos as a pilot test site.

problems.title: Global Export & Payment Gateway for Jos Artisanal Mining & Gemstone Crafters
problems.description: Plateau gemstone miners & lapidary artisans lack direct international escrow, verified authenticity passports, and cross-border payment integration for high-value export markets.

problems.title: Jos Tech Talent Pipeline: Industry-Gated Apprenticeships for Unijos / PLASU Graduates
problems.description: Computer science grads from University of Jos and Plateau State University struggle with practical production code. Need a 12-week open-source project incubator matched with local startup mentors.

comments.author: Ruth E.
comments.text: First cohort of 15 apprentices starting next month at nHub space!

attendees.name: Pamela Dung
attendees.title: Founder @ AgriPlateau ColdHubs
attendees.bio: Building IoT solar cold-storage containers for Irish potato farmers in Bokkos and Mangu.
attendees.giveAsk: Give: IoT firmware / ESP32 architecture help. Ask: Introductions to off-takers and farm cooperatives.

attendees.name: Gyang Kim
attendees.title: Lead Systems Engineer @ PeakMesh
attendees.bio: Setting up failover wireless mesh grids and solar battery backups for tech workspaces in Jos.
attendees.giveAsk: Give: Network routing & cloud server hosting tips. Ask: Landlord permission for rooftop antennas in Rayfield.

attendees.name: Bilikisu Ahmed
attendees.title: Co-Founder @ JosGems Marketplace
attendees.bio: Empowering Plateau artisanal mineral lapidaries with digital escrow verification and global DHL shipping.
attendees.giveAsk: Give: Export customs compliance & UI/UX feedback. Ask: React Native developer for mobile checkout.

attendees.name: Solomon Pwajok
attendees.title: Full-Stack Dev & Unijos CS Mentor
attendees.bio: Passionate about open-source developer tooling and training the next generation of Plateau tech builders.
attendees.giveAsk: Give: Fullstack code reviews (React/Node/Python). Ask: Startup internships for top 10 graduating students.

Infrastructure.description: Roads, transit hubs, internet mesh grids & physical facility access across Jos and Plateau State.

Safety.description: Community security networks, rapid emergency alerts, streetlight power & verified identity systems.

Services.description: Public health access, waste management, municipal tools & digital civic administration for citizens.

Agro-Tech & Cold Chain.description: Solar cold storage, farmer-to-market logistics, soil telemetry & crop preservation in Bokkos/Vom.

Tech Talent & Education.description: University incubators (Unijos/PLASU), developer bootcamps & industry mentorship pipelines.

Commerce & Export.description: Gemstone lapidary exports, artisan escrow, cross-border payment gateways & local trade platforms.

Energy & Power.description: Off-grid renewable power systems, solar micro-grids & battery swap infrastructure for businesses.
